messages:
Maya C: Quick capture from today's FinLaunch onboarding call — putting raw notes here so product/eng can triage. TL;DR: they like latency/quality but hit multiple onboarding & observability pain points that are causing renewal friction.

Maya C: Key asks / pain points (copied almost verbatim):
- SSO + SCIM missing for their IdP — blocks automated user provisioning across teams. (calls this a must-have for pilot -> P0)
- Hard to reconcile cost spikes: they saw a ~3x token bill on day 2 and couldn't map to routes or users. Wants per-route & per-user token attribution + sample request logs. (P1)
- Embeddings/semantic search: currently manual reindexing. They want incremental delta sync + ability to pin embeddings version per deployment. (P1)
- Console UX: rollout status is opaque for canary/rollback, team got confused during a small deploy. Wants clearer per-deployment history + quick rollback button. (P2)
- Prompt/eval import: they run prompt suites in spreadsheets; need CSV importer or API to seed eval sets. (P2)
- FinLaunch asked for a 'Fintech quickstart' template (sample prompts, compliance checklist, recommended batch sizes) — would speed adoption. (P1)

Maya C: Also noted: onboarding engineer (internal) spent ~4 hours debugging API key scoping and rate limits. That time = renewal risk if we can't reduce friction.

Arjun K: Thanks Maya — great summary. I'll triage these into the backlog. Can you add a row in the CS->Product feedback Airtable with the notes? Link that in here so we can reference during roadmap planning. Which of these should we mark P0/P1/P2?

Maya C: I already prioritized inline (P0 = SSO/SCIM; P1 = cost attribution, embeddings delta, quickstart; P2 = console UX polish, CSV importer). Adding Airtable now.

airtable-bot: Added record: https://airtable.com/appRedwood/rec12345 — "FinLaunch onboarding feedback — 2026-11-02" (fields: SSO/P0, billing/P1, embeddings/P1, quickstart/P1, console/P2, csv-import/P2)

Arjun K: Great. @Lena V can you give a quick T-shirt estimate for the P0/P1 items so we can decide if we need to push into the next enterprise sprint? Also want to know any infra risks for embeddings delta sync.

Lena V: Quick questions: for embeddings delta sync — what scale are we talking (docs/day, avg doc size)? Do they need realtime sync or nightly batches? Also SCIM: do they require SCIM v2 + group sync?

Maya C: They said ~200k total docs, daily delta ~2k–5k docs. Avg doc ~1k tokens. Realtime not required for V1; nightly or hourly acceptable. For SCIM they want group sync + deprovisioning (SCIM v2 preferred).

Lena V: Ok thx. Rough ballpark: embeddings delta MVP (nightly incremental + pinned versions) = 2 devs x 3 sprints (infra + worker + hooks) — depends on storage layout. SCIM + SSO (enterprise auth) = 1.5–2 sprints if we reuse existing auth foundations; need security review. Cost attribution (per-route/token breakdown) = 1 dev + data infra changes ~2 sprints. Console rollback UX + history = product + 1 eng ~1–2 sprints.

Arjun K: Helpful — sounds doable but non-trivial. Proposal: mark SSO/SCIM as P0 (enterprise epic), cost attribution + embeddings delta + quickstart as P1 for next planning. CSV importer + UX polish as P2. I'll flag SSO for the enterprise roadmap meeting.

Sam R: From onboarding ops: I'll add the quickstart checklist and schedule a focused enablement session with FinLaunch next Tue. I'll also create a short runbook for the API key scoping issue so new accounts don't hit the same blocker.

Maya C: Appreciate it. For renewal risk — recommend we offer a short-term workaround: dedicated onboarding call + scoped access for provisioning while SSO is implemented. We should log that as an action item in the Airtable.

Arjun K: Agreed. I'll create the epic placeholders and link PRD owners. Can we meet Tues 11/9 11am PT for a 30m triage? Want PM + Eng + CS + Security quick sync.

Lena V: I can make that. I'll prep a basic design note for embeddings delta and infra implications.

Sam R: Added runbook draft to the shared Onboarding folder and pinged FinLaunch for Tue slot.

Maya C: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open for any follow-ups. Will update Airtable with renewal workaround + assigned CS owner. :thumbsup:

Arjun K: I'll slot these into the roadmap doc and follow up with rough timelines after the triage. :eyes:
